parameters.note: Slot 1 (K-410): on a training day, this long before the user's own usual time, in the user's own words. A consistent time and a routine to hang it on are the only two cues that predict the behaviour (I1 C2, r = 0.11-0.13).

SEÇİM, ürün kararı (agent, K-1060, the product owner confirms); no source gives an hour. The usual time the training reminder goes by when the user has told none: onboarding no longer asks for it (ADR-072 #4), so without a default no new user ever got a training reminder. A time the user gave (Schedule.usualTrainingTime) wins; the reminder is training_reminder_lead_minutes before it.

Slot 2: the check-in day (Monday, onboarding.json check_in_day) in the morning. F4 says 'Monday morning'; no source gives the hour (I1 D1: 'no direct evidence for the hour'), so 09:00 is a product choice.
Slot 3: one self-compassion message after this many days without the app opened, only once per quiet spell (I1 C6: self-compassion after a lapse, blame makes it worse).
The user's own routine sentence ('After work, straight to the gym') is the training reminder's body: a lock-screen line, so short.

During a week off (Program.restUntil) training reminders stop (ADR-037 #51b); the training days of this many weeks after it are scheduled by date, so they come back without the app being opened. The next open turns them weekly again.

The meal reminder (the fourth kind, ADR-090 #2) learns the user's usual meal times from the logs of this many days: the median time of day of each slot's logs. Product choice, no source gives a window.
A slot needs at least this many logs in the window before its time counts as a habit; fewer, and the reminder says nothing about it.
At most this many meal reminders a day (ADR-090 #2: a day with two prompts is a nudge, more is nagging). The slots with the most logs win.
The reminder comes this long after the slot's usual time, and only while the slot is still empty as of the last time the app was open: a meal logged on time makes it go quiet.
Meal reminders are planned by date for today and the day after, so they ring with no open needed; every open (a log, the app to the front) plans them again from what is known.
